set -euo pipefail; R="$HOME/agent-workspace/review/photomap-2026-09-12"; DB="$R/app.db"; cat > /tmp/photomap_review_candidates_059.py <<'PY'
import json, os, sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(os.environ['DB'])
c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
rows=c.execute('''SELECT p.id,p.city_id,p.slug,p.title,p.description,p.article_blocks,p.photo_count,p.cover_photo_id,p.status,c.name AS city_name FROM place p JOIN city c ON c.id=p.city_id WHERE p.status='published' ORDER BY CASE WHEN trim(coalesce(p.description,''))='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, length(coalesce(p.description,'')), p.photo_count ASC, p.title LIMIT 20''').fetchall()
for r in rows:
    photos=c.execute('''SELECT id,role,status,caption,public_path,thumb_path,description_blocks FROM photo WHERE place_id=? AND status='approved' ORDER BY CASE WHEN id=? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, approved_at, created_at LIMIT 6''',(r['id'],r['cover_photo_id'])).fetchall()
    item=dict(r)
    item['description_len']=len(r['description'] or '')
    item['photos']=[dict(p) for p in photos]
    print(json.dumps(item,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
c.close()
PY
DB="$DB" python3 /tmp/photomap_review_candidates_059.py
